::: {#exm-backpropagation}

#### Backpropagation through the MLP

@sol-manual-backward is [backpropagation](#def-backpropagation) through the four steps of @sol-loss-operations.
It visits them in reverse order:
the loss gives the gradient at the [logits](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-logits) `g2`;
the second affine step gives the gradients of $\matr{W}_2$, $\vecf{b}_2$ and the [hidden layer](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-hidden-layer);
the [ReLU](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-relu) gives the gradient at $\vz_1$;
and the first affine step gives the gradients of $\matr{W}_1$ and $\vecf{b}_1$.

:::
